name: Smoke Alarm
summary: Round ceiling or wall smoke detector with a red LED; anim beep blinks the light and shows sound arcs.

params.name: y
params.note: wall or ceiling item: centred on y (default 760), no ground shadow

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (about 340 px across)

params.name: anim
params.note: beep = the LED blinks and sound arcs appear

author: krakujs
